properties.name: Recording that one part depends on another is one typed call, and the obvious name means that
properties.statement:
The edge every topology rule reads — component coupling — is recorded through a typed call of its own, and the name an agent reaches for when it means "this part needs that part" resolves to that call rather than to something else.

From musicjug's field report, 2026-08-31: searching for it found `declare_dependency`, which pins a version of ANOTHER DESIGN, and the session fell back to a raw edge write. Accepted on Anthony's word 2026-09-01, together with the rename that frees the name.

⚠️ THIS REQUIREMENT IS ABOUT THE AFFORDANCE, NOT THE MODELLING. It does not say a design must declare its couplings, and satisfying it does not make any design better connected — measured the day it landed, 1 of 70 of reflow2's own components carried any coupling and modularity was therefore not measurable. This removes the excuse; the work stays the designer's.
